founding_decisions.title: Service agreements ownership
founding_decisions.question: Who owns service agreements meaning and lifecycle?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: Keep an explicit service owner with translated boundary contracts.
alternatives: Keep all workflow and data in one undifferentiated job model.
Split each named page into a separate context.
founding_decisions.rationale: Commercial agreement and stable service-subject meaning differ from stock, physical work and accounting.
consequences: Independent ownership of party or asset master data emerges.
Proposed logical boundaries do not require separately deployed services.

founding_decisions.title: Parts supply ownership
founding_decisions.question: Who owns parts supply meaning and lifecycle?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: Keep an explicit parts owner with translated boundary contracts.
alternatives: Keep all workflow and data in one undifferentiated job model.
Split each named page into a separate context.
founding_decisions.rationale: Stock allocation and procurement have distinct ownership and local consistency.
consequences: Independent procurement ownership or high-value serial tracking warrants a further split.
Proposed logical boundaries do not require separately deployed services.

founding_decisions.title: Workshop execution ownership
founding_decisions.question: Who owns workshop execution meaning and lifecycle?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: Keep an explicit execution owner with translated boundary contracts.
alternatives: Keep all workflow and data in one undifferentiated job model.
Split each named page into a separate context.
founding_decisions.rationale: Physical execution, evidence and custody differ from customer commercial approval and stock.
consequences: Field service develops independent scheduling and mobile ownership.
Proposed logical boundaries do not require separately deployed services.

founding_decisions.title: Financial handoff ownership
founding_decisions.question: Who owns financial handoff meaning and lifecycle?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: Keep an explicit finance owner with translated boundary contracts.
alternatives: Keep all workflow and data in one undifferentiated job model.
Split each named page into a separate context.
founding_decisions.rationale: External financial document semantics require translation independently of repair history.
consequences: A selected accounting provider introduces materially different integration semantics.
Proposed logical boundaries do not require separately deployed services.

subdomains.name: Service agreements
subdomains.ownership: party and equipment references; job and diagnosis; issued quote revisions; approval evidence; warranty reference links
subdomains.non_ownership: Other contexts and external account/financial authorities.
invariants: An approval names its exact issued quote revision.
Equipment serial numbers and customer email are not identities.
History does not transfer another party’s private information.
subdomains.lifecycle: Job admitted; diagnosis recorded; quote drafted, issued and responded to; future warranty links preserve source meaning.

subdomains.name: Parts supply
subdomains.ownership: catalog identity; branch stock; reservations; supplier requests and receipts
subdomains.non_ownership: Other contexts and external account/financial authorities.
invariants: A stock unit cannot be reserved twice.
Receipt, usability and consumption are distinct facts.
subdomains.lifecycle: Request, reserve or shortage, purchase, receive, consume, return or scrap; supplier integrations later.

subdomains.name: Workshop execution
subdomains.ownership: technician assignments; work and safety results; issued report revisions; custody and collection facts
subdomains.non_ownership: Other contexts and external account/financial authorities.
invariants: Completion requires the applicable safety review.
One current custody location is reported.
Issued reports retain historical meaning.
subdomains.lifecycle: Schedule, begin, pause, resume, test, issue report, transfer or collect; work can return after a failed test.

subdomains.name: Financial handoff
subdomains.ownership: accounting handoff references; delivery attempts and reconciled outcomes
subdomains.non_ownership: Other contexts and external account/financial authorities.
invariants: Accounting remains financial authority.
An uncertain external outcome is reconciled before retry.
subdomains.lifecycle: Capture reference first; prepare, send, reconcile and correct external handoffs later.
